typography.notes: system font stack, modular scale 1.25 from 16px base, roles: heading-1/heading-2/body/caption

color.notes: 5 hues (primary/neutral/success/warning/danger), 9-step ramps 100-900, primary anchored at #2563EB per user; semantic aliases for text/background/surface/border/primary/focus/status text+surface; status text uses 700-step to hold WCAG 2.2 AA contrast on white

spacing.notes: 4px base scale (0-64px, 9 steps) plus border-radius, border-width, and shadow/elevation tokens; shadow tokens are light-surface only for now

components.name: Text
components.notes: routes all heading/body/caption text through approved typography roles

components.name: Button
components.notes: native <button>, focus-visible ring via --color-focus-ring, aria-busy when loading

components.name: Badge
components.notes: requires a text label; status must not be conveyed by color alone

components.name: TextInput
components.notes: label associated via useId, help/error text wired via aria-describedby, error sets aria-invalid

components.name: Select
components.notes: native <select>, same label/help/error pattern as TextInput

components.name: Checkbox
components.notes: indeterminate set imperatively via ref since it is a DOM property, not an HTML attribute

components.name: Card
components.notes: surface container with optional title/footer slots

components.name: Modal
components.notes: native <dialog> + showModal() for focus trap/inerting/top-layer, aria-labelledby to title, close on Escape/backdrop-click

gaps.description: No real product area exists yet in this greenfield scaffold (App.jsx is a placeholder), so composite-to-page-level patterns were not built. Foundations (typography, color, spacing) and small/interactive/composite components (Text, Button, Badge, TextInput, Select, Checkbox, Card, Modal) are approved and validated. Trigger this layer via /ticket-agent when the first real page/feature needs it.
